title: Core script list and a check that procedures name only scripts adoption provides
goal: core/package-scripts.json lists the scripts of the copied tools; check:template fails when a core procedure names an npm script that adoption does not provide
acceptance: core/package-scripts.json holds work:pr, behaviour and coverage:browser with the other core tool scripts; write-tools.md tells adoption and reconcile to add them

check:template fails on a core procedure naming an npm script missing from package.json, core/package-scripts.json and angular/package-scripts.json (coverage, check:conventions, lint, format and skills:* are stack or skills-repository owned)
A test names the three scripts the audit found missing
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; no personal data.
